Hi Sofia — sorry for the friction. Quick checklist to ensure Ariba accepts the supplier:  
1) W-9 must include the EIN in the EIN field (not handwritten) and match the legal name on the Ariba profile.
2) Uploaded filename should be simple (e.g., Optima_W9.pdf). Some vendors retain metadata that trips validation — try exporting from Adobe/Preview to a new PDF.
3) Complete the Redwood onboarding spreadsheet I attached earlier — bank account and remittance contact are required for PO autoflow.

I’ve created a short DocuSign package for Optima to e-sign (W-9 confirmation + payment terms) — Sofia, please sign using this link: https://docusign.com/s/ABC12345. If uploading a corrected W-9 doesn’t clear in Ariba, reply here and I’ll open a support ticket with Ariba and include the vendor EIN for manual verification.

Ben / Laura — attaching the checklist and DocuSign link should cover our side.
